title: 10-minute Dance Exercise to Release Stress & Anxiety 🌱 Very Grounding!

method.teacher_system: The teacher guides the learner through deep breathing and somatic grounding movements to release stress and tension from the body. She combines foot planting and hip loosening exercises with shaking to release negative energy and create space for new vitality.
method.signature: Using guided somatic shaking and visualization of releasing anxiety down into the floor to regulate the nervous system.

practices.what: Takes deep breaths in and out with arm stretches, imagining breath traveling from the soles of the feet through the whole body.
Lowers center of gravity, shifting weight from side to side and loosening up hips to connect with the ground.
Widens stance and firmly plants and lifts feet, putting energy and intention into the grounding movement.
Performs somatic shaking starting from the legs, moving up through the hips and upper body to release stress.
Transitions into gentle wave-like upper body and shoulder movements to create spaciousness and flexibility.

beliefs.belief: Dancing is a tool to release stress, anxiety, and tension from the body while making space for new, vital energy.
Connecting to the floor helps move our focus away from the mind and release physical tension stored in the upper body.
Being gentle with oneself and giving permission to relax is a key part of the dance practice.

feelings.response: The teacher explains that anxiety causes tension in the chest and head, and suggests connecting to the floor to release it.
The teacher asks the learner what they want to release and what is no longer serving them, encouraging them to let it pour out.
The teacher asks the learner what they need to shake out today, normalizing the need to release tension.
The teacher acknowledges that hips hold many emotions like fear and control, and suggests adding movement to release that tension.

moments.says: The teacher welcomes the learner and introduces herself, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere for the session.
The teacher guides the learner to lower their center of gravity, preparing them for the grounding exercises to follow.
The teacher encourages the learner to be silly and let their voice out, preparing them for a full-body shake.
The teacher invites the learner to focus on their hips, acknowledging that they hold tension and emotions.

mentor.what_stays: The teacher leaves the learner feeling empowered to release tension and embrace their own body's natural movement.

struggles.theme: Struggling with anxiety, panic attacks, stress, and trauma release

clicked.theme: The somatic shaking and breathing unexpectedly brought emotional release, crying, and laughter

requests.theme: Asking for more videos and sessions from Tamara

meant.theme: Saved them from panic attacks and anxiety, acting as a transformative healing journey

method.limits: The video is performed in a single front view without spoken technical breakdown of footwork, focusing entirely on guided somatic movement.
